description: A single-panel vertical flow diagram (screening scheme) summarising the two-stage optimisation workflow of Fe-Mn-Al-C austenitic low-density steels. It is built from three stacked circles, each holding blue dots that represent candidate compositions; the dot density visibly decreases downwards — the top circle is densely packed, the middle sparser, the bottom contains only a few dots. Grey downward arrows labelled "Screen out" (text rotated vertically) separate the stages. To the right of each circle, an orange banner prints the candidate count and a yellow tab names the region: "All possible 78,477 candidates" (Area A), "All possible 1320 candidates" (Area B), "All possible 150 candidates" (Area C). Two pale-blue boxes list the boundary conditions applied at each step: the first, between Area A and Area B, reads "Boundary condition: κ phase exist; A single γ region; (γ+κ) region in 500-600°C"; the second, between Area B and Area C, reads "Boundary condition: κ fraction ≥ 10%; Density ≤ 7 g/cm³". The figure demonstrates that a search space of 78,477 compositions is first cut to 1,320 by phase-boundary screening and then to 150 κ-rich, low-density candidates.

observations.observation: The scheme is organised as three stacked circles whose blue-dot density decreases from top to bottom, visualising progressive filtering of the candidate composition space.
The top circle carries the printed label 'All possible 78,477 candidates' with the yellow tag 'Area A'.
The middle circle carries the printed label 'All possible 1320 candidates' with the yellow tag 'Area B'.
The bottom circle carries the printed label 'All possible 150 candidates' with the yellow tag 'Area C'.
Two grey rotated arrows, each labelled 'Screen out', link the consecutive circles, indicating the two filtration steps of the workflow.
One boundary-condition box states the screening criteria 'κ phase exist; A single γ region; (γ+κ) region in 500-600°C'.
The other boundary-condition box states 'κ fraction ≥ 10%' and 'Density ≤ 7 g/cm³'.

The figure is described as a scheme of the optimisation process of Fe-Mn-Al-C austenitic low-density steels whose screening is divided into a phase-component step and a step screening other features (high κ-phase content Y4 and low density Y5), leaving 150 candidates.
The citing text states that 78,477 possible composition-feature combinations were enumerated to predict Y1, Y2, Y3 and Y4 using screened models.

The citing text states the first stage screened process parameters and structures (Y1, Y2, Y3), with boundary conditions set in composition space to locate a single γ region, a (γ+κ) region at 500-600°C, and κ phases, yielding 1,320 satisfactory candidates.
The citing text states the second stage was performance filtering for Y4 and low density, giving 150 candidates with high κ fractions (more than 10%) and low density (less than or equal to 7 g/cm³).

subfigures.description: A large circle densely filled with blue dots, labelled 'All possible 78,477 candidates' and 'Area A', representing the full initial composition space; a rotated grey arrow labelled 'Screen out' leads downwards. An adjacent pale-blue box lists the boundary condition: κ phase exist; A single γ region; (γ+κ) region in 500-600°C.

A circle with clearly fewer blue dots (moderate spacing), labelled 'All possible 1320 candidates' and 'Area B', the surviving space after the first screening; below it a second rotated arrow labelled 'Screen out' and a pale-blue box listing the boundary condition: κ fraction ≥ 10%; Density ≤ 7 g/cm³.
A circle containing only a small cluster of four to five blue dots, labelled 'All possible 150 candidates' and 'Area C', the final optimised search space after both screening steps.
